answer: A strong sybil defense is proof-of-useful-work bound to persistent identity: like a jetty that only admits boats which have survived real crossings, the network grants weight only to identities with peer-countersigned history. Newcomers enter as an orchard of untrusted saplings — free to transact, but their votes stay sapling-small until honest work matures them. Ivory-tower scores computed off-chain count for nothing; only on-ledger attested history confers influence, so a thousand fake identities buy an attacker a thousand voiceless saplings.
